ui_bugs.issue: Same seeded records appear TWICE (once as booking AY-2026-DEMO-00X, once as inquiry INQ-2026-00X) causing 6 rows instead of 3. React logs 'Encountered two children with the same key' warnings for booking ids 8ec4ab11-..., 1f7f2f89-..., 575af81e-... The /api/customer/trips endpoint concatenates bookings + inquiries without deduping by id.
Total Spent card shows ₹0 despite Completed=4 — seeded bookings appear to have total_amount missing/null so statistics.total_spent sum is 0

issues: Radix warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}' — add aria-describedby / DialogDescription for a11y

action_items: Deduplicate results in /api/customer/trips (customer_routes.py::get_my_trips) — when a record with same id exists in both bookings and inquiries, prefer bookings and drop the duplicate inquiry (or vice-versa). Currently every seeded record surfaces twice in UI.

Populate total_amount (or estimated_price) on seeded completed bookings so statistics.total_spent reflects a non-zero value; alternatively make get_my_trips fall back to accepted_quote.amount / estimated_price when total_amount is missing.
Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to PostFlightRating DialogContent to remove Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: customer_routes.py::get_my_trips concatenates bookings and inquiries collections but does not dedupe by id — this produces duplicated cards in every customer UI that renders 'trips' (Dashboard Recent Bookings + MyTrips). Add: seen=set(); all_trips=[t for t in bookings+inquiries if t['id'] not in seen and not seen.add(t['id'])].
customer_routes.py::submit_booking_rating still uses primitive query params for a complex payload; migrate to a Pydantic body model (reported in iteration_41 — still open).
customer_routes.py::get_booking_rating (GET) does not enforce booking ownership via db.bookings/inquiries lookup for the current user — potential info leak (reported in iteration_41 — still open).
